# 3 bed terraced house for sale

> Berkeley & Associates are delighted to bring 114 Palmerstown Avenue to the market, an impressive three-bedroom mid-terrace family home with a converted attic, ideally positioned on this highly sought-after residential avenue in Palmerstown.
